name: Seacon Shipping Group Holdings Limited
summary: Seacon Shipping Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides integrated shipping services in the People's Republic of China. The company operates in two segments, Shipping Business and Ship Management Business. It offers shipping services for commodity owners, traders, and shipping service companies through its controlled or chartered-in vessels, which transport dry bulks, bunkers, and petrochemical products.
